newsitem.title: USA: Grove expects 97 funds from operations $1.02.
newsitem.headline: Grove expects 97 funds from operations $1.02.

text.p: Grove Property Trust said on Wednesday it expects funds from operations on a per share and operating unit basis to be in the range of $1.02 in 1997 versus the prior year proforma of $0.94.
The company said it bought three additional apartment communities for $26 million on June 1, 1997.
On March 14, 1997, it consolidated 20 additional properties into the company.
Grove Property said it intents to buy five additional apartment communities in Edgartown, Martha's Vineyard for $27.1 million.
The acquisitions will be purchased with a combination of operating units, cash and debt.
